svg.title: Spatial challenger: prediction error across frozen evaluations
svg.desc: Percentage error reduction relative to the context baseline. Positive is better. Black is later submitted tasks; red dashed is unseen geometry. This measures predictions, not discovery odds.

g.text: 205 frozen evaluations · 210,944 training-boundary tasks · SHADOW: no production influence
Y: reduction in mean absolute log1p error versus context baseline. Above zero = lower prediction error.
Historical backfills are retrospective. Better predictions do not establish better discovery odds.
